spellbook.finance/limitations: Receipts preserve customer or agent observations and source timestamps as submitted evidence. They do not verify providers, inspected card truth, profit, or completed work.

A linked work observation creates a second immutable receipt without changing its consideration. Replays require the same workspace, submissionId, and canonical request; reuse the same submissionId and body after an uncertain outcome.
Separate source retrieval tools keep their existing entitlements. Evidence submission is available to authenticated workspace members and does not imply source access or change a consideration.

description: List a bounded page of private evidence receipts from the selected workspace, optionally filtered by receipt kind, parent, or item ID.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page, passed back unchanged. Omit to start from the first page.

itemId.description: Restrict the list to receipts referencing this exact item id. Omit for no item filter.

kind.description: Restrict the list to one receipt kind. Omit to include every kind.

limit.description: Maximum receipts to return, 1 to 50. Omit for the default of 20.

parentReceiptId.description: Restrict the list to receipts linked to this parent receipt's receiptId from the record response. Omit for no parent filter.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to list receipts from. Required.

name: spellbook_customer_evidence_list
